five_dataset_concepts.conceptual_distinction_statement: 1. Source Image: Raw photographic frame (2,812 files). 2. Annotated Instance: Specific bounding-box crop & mask (5,714 items). 3. Physical Garment: Distinct physical item (4,862 distinct items, accounting for multi-garment ensembles and multi-views). 4. Product Identity: Commercial design / model line (2,812 products). 5. Catalogue Listing: Merchant record / SKU.

split_isolation_audit.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED_PASS (0 parent image collisions and 0 product collisions across splits)
split_isolation_audit.data_isolation_compliance: All views, crops, and annotations belonging to the same physical garment/image are strictly locked to one split.

flatlay_representation_forensics.forensic_finding: The 2,185 training representations in Phase 14.1 were neutral-letterboxed crops synthesized from isolated garment instances to force the CNN backbone to ignore human context. True raw unsegmented flat-lay photos remained severely scarce (39 in train, 8 in holdout), explaining why raw flat-lay accuracy lagged behind isolated flat-lay accuracy (12.5% vs 64.0%).
